The '''Support Service Branch''' was a division of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. It provided support services to allow the personnel of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] to carry out their duties.<ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref> It was responsible for specialty systems, such as medical, navigation, communication and weapons.<ref name="Handbook">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref> The main divisions of the branch were [[Ordnance]], which installed and maintained armaments; [[Gunnery]], which supplied personnel to use the armaments; [[Communications]], responsible for handling information systems and traffic; [[Biological]], charged with medical services and research; and [[Astrogation (section)|Astrogation]], responsible for [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] and navigation-related matters.<ref name="ISB2">[[Imperial Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''Imperial Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref>
